Corkscrew with interest on the average balance, added to the balance

/*  FUNCTION NAME:  CorkscrewRateλ
    DESCRIPTION:*//**Create a corkscrew whose interest is charged on the average of each period's opening and closing balances and added to the balance*/

CorkscrewRateλ = LAMBDA(
//  Parameter Declaration
    [Opening],
    [Rates],
    [Flow1],
    [Flow2],
    [Flow3],
    [Flow4],
    LET(
    //  Help
        Help,           TRIM(TEXTSPLIT(
                            "FUNCTION:      →CorkscrewRateλ(Opening, Rates, Flow1, [Flow2], [Flow3], [Flow4])¶" &
                            "DESCRIPTION:   →Create a corkscrew whose interest is charged on the average balance and added to it.¶NOTES!         →Each period's interest is its rate times the average of its opening and¶               →closing balances, and the closing balance includes that interest. Each¶               →period is solved in closed form, without iteration or a circular reference:¶               →closing = (opening * (2 + rate) + 2 * flows) / (2 - rate). The rows are the¶               →opening balance, the flows, the interest and the closing balance. Every rate¶               →must be a number above -1 and below 2, Opening a single number and every¶               →flow a number or blank; anything else returns a message.¶" &
                            "WEBPAGE:       →https://github.com/ryanduguid/Ozzit¶" &
                            "VERSION:       →1 Nov 2026¶" &
                            "PARAMETERS:    →¶" &
                            "Opening        →(Required) First periods opening balance.¶" &
                            "Rates          →(Required) The interest rate per period: one rate for every period, or one row with a rate for each, such as DayCountRateλ().¶" &
                            "Flow1          →(Required) First row (or array of rows) of numbers to include in period totals.¶" &
                            "Flow2          →(Optional) Second row (or array of rows) of numbers to include in period totals.¶" &
                            "Flow3          →(Optional) Third row (or array of rows) of numbers to include in period totals.¶" &
                            "Flow4          →(Optional) Fourth row (or array of rows) of numbers to include in period totals.¶" &
                            "NOTE!          →All flows are added. To subtract a flow make it negative.¶" &
                            "EXAMPLES:      →¶" &
                            "→Formula (oz is assumed to be the module's name)¶" &
                            "→=oz.CorkscrewRateλ(1000, 0.01, {100,100})¶" &
                            "→Result¶" &
                            "→1000.00, 1110.55¶" &
                            "→100.00, 100.00¶" &
                            "→10.55, 11.66¶" &
                            "→1110.55, 1222.22",
                            "→", "¶"
                        )),
    //  Check inputs - Omitted required arguments
        Help?,          OR(ISOMITTED(Opening), ISOMITTED(Rates), ISOMITTED(Flow1)),
    //  Procedure
        Cols,           COLUMNS(Flow1),
        Rows,           IF(ISOMITTED(Flow2), 1,
                            IF(ISOMITTED(Flow3), 2,
                                IF(ISOMITTED(Flow4), 3, 4)
                            )
                        ),
        PeriodArray,    SWITCH(Rows,
                            1, Flow1,
                            2, VSTACK(Flow1, Flow2),
                            3, VSTACK(Flow1, Flow2, Flow3),
                            4, VSTACK(Flow1, Flow2, Flow3, Flow4)
                        ),
        PeriodTotal,    BYCOL(PeriodArray, LAMBDA(Col, SUM(Col))),
    //  SUM leaves text and TRUE out of a total, so a flow typed as text would show but not
    //  count. A blank or "" is nil, and an error passes so it shows.
        ValidFlows?,    NOT(OR(IFERROR(ISLOGICAL(PeriodArray) + ISTEXT(PeriodArray) * (PeriodArray <> ""), FALSE))),
        ValidOpening?,  AND(ROWS(Opening) = 1, COLUMNS(Opening) = 1, IFERROR(ISNUMBER(Opening) + (Opening = ""), TRUE)),
        Start,          IF(Opening = "", 0, Opening),
    //  One rate applies to every period; otherwise there is one for each
        Shaped?,        AND(ROWS(Rates) = 1, OR(COLUMNS(Rates) = 1, COLUMNS(Rates) = Cols)),
        RateRow,        IF(COLUMNS(Rates) = 1, EXPAND(Rates, 1, Cols, INDEX(Rates, 1, 1)), Rates),
    //  At a rate of 2 the closed form divides by nought; a blank rate is a missing period
        ValidRates?,    AND(IFERROR(ISNUMBER(RateRow) * (RateRow > -1) * (RateRow < 2) = 1, TRUE)),
        ShapeMessage,   "CorkscrewRateλ needs Rates to be one rate, or one row with a rate for each period.",
        RateMessage,    "CorkscrewRateλ needs every rate to be a number above -1 and below 2.",
        OpeningMessage, "CorkscrewRateλ needs Opening to be a single number.",
        FlowMessage,    "CorkscrewRateλ needs every flow to be a number or blank.",
    //  Interest on the average balance, I = r * (O + C) / 2, with C = O + F + I, gives
    //  C = (O * (2 + r) + 2 * F) / (2 - r). The closing balance is the only state carried
    //  from one period to the next, so solve the closings in one pass and read the rest off.
        Closings,       SCAN(Start, SEQUENCE( , Cols),
                            LAMBDA(Acc, Col,
                                LET(Rate, INDEX(RateRow, 1, Col),
                                    (Acc * (2 + Rate) + 2 * INDEX(PeriodTotal, 1, Col)) / (2 - Rate))
                            )
                        ),
        Openings,       IF(Cols = 1, Start, HSTACK(Start, DROP(Closings, , -1))),
        Interest,       RateRow * (Openings + Closings) / 2,
        Result,         VSTACK(Openings, PeriodArray, Interest, Closings),
    //  Return Result, Help or the message
        Return,         IF(Help?, 2, IF(NOT(Shaped?), 3, IF(NOT(ValidRates?), 4,
                            IF(NOT(ValidOpening?), 5, IF(NOT(ValidFlows?), 6, 1))))),
        CHOOSE( Return, Result, Help, ShapeMessage, RateMessage, OpeningMessage, FlowMessage)
    )
);
